stories.title: White Sox 9, Tigers 5 — AL Central Lead Grows to 3.5 Games in Series Opener

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: The White Sox just answered Detroit's must-win framing with a 9-5 win in Game 1. Vargas hit two. Murakami and Peters went deep. Four Chicago home runs at Comerica. AL Central lead: 3.5 games. #WhiteSox #Tigers

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: One year ago the White Sox were 41-121. Now they're 63-58, lead the AL Central by 3.5 games, and just crushed Detroit in a series opener Detroit called a must-win. The rebuild is real. #WhiteSox

article.headline: White Sox 9, Tigers 5 — Chicago Blows Open AL Central Lead to 3.5 Games in Series Opener

stories.title: Matt Olson Is the Hottest HR Hitter in Baseball — 7 HRs in His Last 11 Games

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text: Matt Olson has hit 7 home runs in his last 11 games — the hottest power stretch in baseball right now. He's at 35 HRs. Schwarber leads at 37. Alvarez hasn't gone deep since July 28. This HR race is Schwarber vs. Olson. #Braves

article.headline: Matt Olson Has Hit 7 Home Runs in 11 Games — The HR Race Has a New Threat

stories.title: Misiorowski Takes the Loss to the Dodgers (3-1) — His Cy Young Case Doesn't Blink

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text: Jacob Misiorowski lost 3-1 to the Dodgers last night. He's now 11-6. His ERA is 1.76. His WHIP is 0.73. He has 204 strikeouts — 2nd-fastest to 200 Ks in MLB history. He still owns the NL Cy Young at -550 odds. #Brewers

article.headline: Misiorowski Lost to the Dodgers 3-1. His Cy Young Case Didn't Move an Inch.

stories.title: Cubs Blank Cardinals 3-0 — NL Wild Card Lead Now 6 Games With 40 to Play

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: Cubs blanked the Cardinals 3-0 last night. They're 71-51. They lead the NL Wild Card by 6 games over the Padres. About 40 games left. This thing is almost over. #Cubs

article.headline: Cubs Blank the Cardinals 3-0 — NL Wild Card Lead Is Now 6 Games With 40 to Play

stories.title: Yordan Alvarez Is 0 HRs in August — The HR Race Is Leaving Him Behind

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: Yordan Alvarez is batting .297 in August. He also hasn't hit a single home run since July 28. He entered August tied for the MLB HR lead at 35. He's now watching Olson surge and the race run away from him. #Astros

article.headline: Yordan Alvarez Has Hit Zero Home Runs in August — The HR Race May Be Leaving Him Behind
